name: Boku to Koi Suru Ponkotsu Akuma. Suggoi Ecchi!
original_name: 僕と恋するポンコツアクマ。 すっごいえっち！
source:
This is the fandisc for Boku to Koisuru Ponkotsu Akuma., featuring after stories for the five heroines, plus new routes for Rin, Aifa and Reika. There will also be a harem route!

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/05/01/may-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是《Boku to Koisuru Ponkotsu Akuma.》的同人光盘，收录了五位女主角的后续故事，以及凛、爱法和丽华的新路线。还会有后宫路线！

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/05/01/may-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
